title: Implement frame-by-frame extraction and processing in UI
description: Update the Lit frontend's FrameExtractor to extract and push frames sequentially into the WASM compiler to avoid browser OOMs.

title: Implement chunked frame encoding to reduce memory pressure
description: Implement chunked frame encoding in WASM to allow progressive GIF generation without loading all frames into memory.

title: MP4/WebM Benchmark Integration: Native decoding in the CLI suite
description: Add native video decoding (WebM/MP4) capabilities directly inside the CLI benchmarking tool to avoid relying on external FFmpeg calls.

title: Automated CI/CD for Crate Quality
description: Integrate formatting, clippy warnings, unit tests, and example checks into a pre-publishing quality pipeline.

title: Optimal LZW: Look-ahead string matching logic
description: Prototype look-ahead matching in LzwEncoder to optimize dictionary index selections for maximum compression ratio.

title: Create 'Gradient Stress' synthetic fixture
description: Generate a synthetic video containing slow color gradients to evaluate K-Means and ordered dithering banding thresholds.

title: Implement A/B Comparative Jury in judge.rs
description: Extend judge.rs to run side-by-side relative comparisons between two GIF outputs to establish a cleaner MOS baseline.

title: New Evaluation Suite: High, med, low quality presets
description: Develop a new automated sweep suite to test Gifsicle/FFmpeg/Pixie-Anim metrics on High, Medium, and Low quality presets.

title: Add end-to-end integration test for WebM to GIF
description: Create an integration test verifying full E2E WebM decoding to optimized GIF conversion.

title: Implement Vitest suite for video-engine logic
description: Implement a Vitest unit testing suite in the web workspace to verify typescript video extraction, demuxing, and canvas scaling logic.

title: Implement WASM-to-Native Parity Tests
description: Implement regression parity tests comparing output byte arrays between wasm32 and native targets to verify algorithm precision parity.

title: Add 'Black Area' histogram regression test
description: Add a histogram-based regression test specifically verifying black area color preservation under K-Means clustering.

title: 3D Spatio-Temporal Dither Kernel: Research & Prototype
description: Research and prototype a 3D Spatio-Temporal Dither Kernel to completely eliminate cross-frame shimmering.

title: Weighted CIELAB Palette Sampling: Improve color accuracy
description: Implement Weighted CIELAB Palette Sampling in KMeansQuantizer to improve color accuracy for visually important areas.

title: WebP Support: Prototype a zero-dependency WebP Lossless (VP8L) encoder
description: Begin research and draft a simple, zero-dependency WebP lossless/lossy frame encoder.

title: Analyze Gemini Judge Paradox: AI evaluation consistency
description: Examine LLM scoring behavior regarding high-frequency shimmering vs soft banding artifacts.
